to measure infectious disease burden and inform public health decisions.

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const italicPattern = /\\?<i\\?>(.*?)\\?<\/i\\?>/g;

  for (const title of document.querySelectorAll(".publication-title a")) {
    const text = title.textContent;
    const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
    let lastIndex = 0;

    for (const match of text.matchAll(italicPattern)) {
      fragment.append(document.createTextNode(text.slice(lastIndex, match.index)));
      const italic = document.createElement("i");
      italic.textContent = match[1];
      fragment.append(italic);
      lastIndex = match.index + match[0].length;
    }

    fragment.append(document.createTextNode(text.slice(lastIndex)));
    title.replaceChildren(fragment);
  }
});
</script>
